title: RetentionActionDue
description: Raised when a disposition becomes due and no legal hold applies. A document under legal hold cannot be archived or disposed regardless of its retention schedule (TAD 7.2). Consumers: records, notification. Delivery: at-least-once.

holdApplied.description: This event is only raised when no hold applies.

requiresApproval.description: Defensible deletion requires records officer approval.
